text:
maya: Quick sync 026-02-19: int4 canary traffic shows ~2.9% "double tool_start" events where the model emits the same func_call twice in one session. Not JSON parse errors, but duplicate invocations reaching call-adapter.
rong: Reproduced on mirror. The two invokes are semantically identical but have different runtime request ids. Downstream sees two tool_start logs, usually only one tool_return.
devin: Any pattern on timing? first vs second emission delta?
maya: Median gap ~120ms, but long tail to 5s. Correlates with slow KV cache warmup and occasional network reassembly on streaming chunks.
sana: Hypothesis: server-side retry logic times out early on initial stream and retries; generator continues and emits func_call again after retry. The adapter dedupe uses strict request_id equality, so it misses this.
devin: Can you paste a sanitized example?
maya: Sure:
```
# call-adapter ingest logs
[2026-02-19T09:02:12Z] recv chunk id=xx seq=0 model=raven-int4-canary
{"fn":"search","args":{"q":"bar"},"_chunk":"t=0..18"}
[2026-02-19T09:02:12Z] retry sent request temp_id=r10
[2026-02-19T09:02:12Z] recv chunk id=xx seq=1
{"fn":"search","args":{"q":"bar"},"_chunk":"t=0..48"}
```
Two chunks reconstruct similar JSON but adapter treats them as separate because temp_id differs.
rong: If payload bytes differ slightly (whitespace/newline), our equality check fails.
sana: Short-term mitigation proposal: compute a stable fingerprint: concat(tool_name, canonicalize_json(args)) then hash. Canonicalize steps: sort object keys, normalize whitespace, unify common escape sequences, remove trailing commas. Use fingerprint + sliding window (e.g., 6s) to dedupe.
devin: Risk: legitimate retries with updated args could be suppressed. Add heuristic: compare arg diffs; if diff > threshold, don't dedupe. Also emit a metric for suppressed_retries.
maya: Also propose to extend idempotency token lifetime for in-flight streaming so retries preserve same id. That requires runtime change but is safer long-term.
rong: For validation: run AB: 1% traffic with fingerprint dedupe enabled for raven-int4-canary for 12h. Measure duplicate_tool_start rate, suppressed legitimate-retry rate, and latency reg change.
sana: I'll build a small harness against mirror: sample 20k sessions, annotate duplicates, store 200 raw stream artifacts (raw + repaired) in private bucket for debugging. Will also compute tokenization delta (differences in reconstructed tokens between first and second stream).
devin: Make sure to mark sample artifacts with tags: model, quant, canary, session_id.
maya: deploy-bot: start AB for raven-int4-canary 1% with flag fp_dedupe=true
deploy-bot: @maya Rolling out raven-int4-canary with fp_dedupe=true at 1% traffic. Watch the deployment dashboard.
rong: For the fingerprint algorithm: use deterministic JSON serialization with sorted keys, replace multiple whitespace sequences with single spaces, normalize escape sequences (\n vs \u000A), remove insignificant trailing commas and null-ish fillers. Hash with xxhash64 for speed.
sana: I'll include unit tests: pairs of chunked reconstructions that should canonicalize to same fingerprint. Also fuzz generator to ensure no collision regressions at 1e6 samples.
devin: Ops checklist: ensure downstream tools are idempotent for repeated tool_start (at least for lookup/search). Add circuit breaker to avoid repeated heavy operations.
maya: Also guard against JSON-repair heuristics hiding root cause: store both raw and repaired payloads for analysis. Don't auto-repair before storing until we triage.
rong: If AB reduces duplicates from ~3% -> <0.3% without increasing missed retries, we can consider promoting. If not, schedule runtime idempotency token work.
sana: I'll post first metrics once we hit 250k mirrored requests (should be ~3 hours at current load).
maya: Thanks. If anyone sees a spike in tool errors or latency, abort the AB and roll back flag. :warning:
devin: Noted. I'll add a quick dashboard tile for duplicate_tool_start rate and suppressed_retry rate.
sana: Will also produce CSV of tokenization deltas so ML team can inspect tokenizer-induced variance.
maya: Closing thread for now, will update with harness link and initial numbers.
